end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Named cylinder for a round candle, sphere for a ball, and cube for a dice.
Counted flat faces in responses involving shapes.
Repeatedly said a cone’s name changes when the cap is turned or upside down; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying 3D shapes using familiar objects such as a dice, candle, ball and cap. Aditya used the examples to name cylinder, sphere and cube. They mixed up whether turning a shape changes its name, and this was still unresolved at the end. At home, turn a cone-shaped object around together and repeat: “It is still a cone from every direction.”
